---
title: "About"
---

I am Yuki Toyoda, a professor at the Graduate School of Innovation Management, Hosei University (Tokyo). I teach MBA courses in business data analysis, research methodology, and marketing science. My research covers qualitative comparative analysis (QCA), marketing science, brand management, and statistics.

## What you will find here

- Posts about threshold-sweep QCA and the ThSQCA R package
- Notes on QCA methodology and data analysis in R
- Browser-based helper tools for generating R code
